name: Hyper Wish
original_name: ハイパー・ウィッシュ
source:
Narumi Sakurai is a 3rd year university student with a problem: her crush, Hibiki Sano, completely ignores her! Suffice to say, when her attempt to finally confess goes down the drain once again thanks to Hibiki’s airhead nature she feels kinda irritated. Oh, if only she’d turn into a more honest person! 

But as they say, ‘Be careful what you wish for’. It’ s a lesson Narumi learns the hard way when the thing she picks up on the street that looks like a genie lamp…actually has a young man in an Arabian outfit appear before her, offering to grant 3 wishes. Already being annoyed from her failure, without thinking she demands for him to make her into a ‘girl that’s honest about the feelings in her own heart’. Wish granted, it’s the start of a giant headache. More so when you add Narumi’s childhood friend/yandere shota stalker, Shimizu Ren, into the mix.

Use the 2nd wish to cancel the first one? As if! No way she’d waste it on something like that. With only 3 days as the time limit, she’ll have to think of a way to best use the remaining ones while escaping the embarrassing results of the ‘curse’ that is the 1st one.

[edited from [url=http://koorinokokoro.wordpress.com/2011/04/22/otome-game-review-hyper-wish-by-nandapanda/]Koorin's blog[/url]]
translation:
樱井成美是一名大学三年级学生，她遇到了一个问题：暗恋的佐野响完全不把她放在眼里！由于响天生迷糊，她一次次鼓起勇气表白，却总是以失败告终，心里自然十分恼火。要是她能变成一个更坦率的人就好了！

然而，正如人们所说：“许愿要小心”。成美在街上捡到一个看似神灯的物件后，终于深刻体会到这句话的含义。神灯中真的出现了一名身穿阿拉伯服装的青年，并提出可以实现三个愿望。成美正为表白失败而烦恼，想也没想便要求他把自己变成一个“能够坦率面对内心感情的女孩”。愿望实现了，却也成了巨大麻烦的开端。更糟的是，成美的儿时好友、病娇正太跟踪狂清水莲也被卷了进来。

用第二个愿望取消第一个愿望？才不要！她绝不会把愿望浪费在这种事上。时限只有三天，她必须想办法善用剩余愿望，同时躲避第一个“诅咒”带来的尴尬后果。

[编辑自[url=http://koorinokokoro.wordpress.com/2011/04/22/otome-game-review-hyper-wish-by-nandapanda/]Koorin的博客[/url]]
